title: Going public with the find through Expressen

tellings.quote: So, I talked to a journalist here in Stockholm, Expressen is a big newspaper.

plain: In 2011 the Swedish treasure hunter Dennis Asberg went public with a strange object his team says it found on the seafloor by taking it to a journalist at Expressen, a big Stockholm newspaper. Asberg tells Michels this himself. It is how word of the find first got out to the public.
